series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction with moderate strength and present seasonality. High model disagreement and unstable rankings suggest a weighted combination with inverse RMSE weighting is appropriate, avoiding single-model selection due to ranking instability.

reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.4357 shows significant model heterogeneity; inverse weighting captures performance differences with shrinkage to prevent overfitting
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false (3 unique per-horizon winners); per-horizon selection adds value

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2; ridge overfits with few training windows
